ironcalc.clientes_inventario.xlsx|Resumen!B20: IronCalc's formatter rounds the binary double; Excel first rounds to 15 significant digits, so x.xx5 values (and times built by adding TIME()) display one unit lower (e.g. 11:29 instead of 11:30).
